_costRationale: Space effector: standoff (non-kinetic) electronic-warfare profile — cheaper/faster than the kinetic effector (no physical rendezvous required) but broader regime reach, since jamming/deception doesn't require physical proximity. Disrupt/Deny/Degrade/Deceive capability, never Destroy (non-kinetic). Pending R-1xx grounding (BL-0017) and IP-4010's actual effect-application wiring.
